regime_context: Detector shows broad eligible rotation (8/16 themes) with Oil & Gas Producers as the clear leader, but leadership breadth is only moderately broad (absorption 0.31) and the leader is crowded. Absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps true), so trend discipline genuinely helps de-risk, but momentum rank itself is attention-only (rank-IC ~0). Track record shows 64.6% hit rate but direction accuracy only 0.343 — lean low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Technology (XIT.TO, currently rank 7, crowded_z 1.25) can improve its durability_bar above 0.70 AND reduce crowding_z below 0.8 simultaneously — that combination (resilient trend health + crowding relief) would be the observable confirming the attention unwinds into a real trend; until then it is attention-only and not a call.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Trend gate validates staying-power discipline in this market, and Oil & Gas is the only eligible, scorable, rank-1 theme with durable breadth (0.786) and strong durability_bar (0.68). However crowding_z 1.04 flags it as crowded — this is a size-down caution only, not a fade. The lean is that trend participation persists while the absolute-trend gate holds; it is not a prediction of further outperformance, only that theme leadership has not broken.
evidence: gate_helps true — trend-gate reduces drawdown on this market
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.04 and unscheduled surprise share 0.75 in macro backdrop suggest attention-driven top risk; crowding flags often mark exhaustion of the theme's marginal buyers, and reflexivity could unwind the rank-1 leadership quickly.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO breaks below its own 60-day simple moving average and stays below for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is rank 2, eligible, and NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.2). It has a modest durability_bar (0.48) but much weaker breadth (0.267), so leadership is narrow — the thesis is weak participation rather than a strong case. The rotation leader margin (0.502) shows Gold as the closest challenger, but not yet confirmed handoff, so no leadership switch is claimed.
evidence: crowded false — crowding_z 0.2, no reflexivity caution
theses.dissent: Breadth 0.267 is poor — leadership rests on very few names; a couple of large sell orders could collapse the rank without broad tape deterioration, and mean-revert hurst_tag is absent but Gold's durability is only 0.48.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO falls below its 90-day simple moving average and Gold Miners drops out of the top-3 eligible rank within 15 trading days

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals is rank 3 and eligible but has mean-revert hurst_tag and near-zero breadth (0.111). The mean-revert tag in a trend-following discipline is the cautionary leg — this theme has historically reverted from lead positions on this market, so trend participation is structurally weak here. Avoid rather than active underweight, since mean-revert is not a short signal under the validated gate.
theses.dissent: Copper can go on sustained runs when geopolitical supply fears spike, and the macro backdrop has 3/12 recent themes tagged geopolitics; a supply-shock could override mean-revert history for a window.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO posts 5-day forward relative strength in the top half of eligible themes and breadth rises above 0.5 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
